+def _routed_profile_for_override(runner: Any, source: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    """The profile an inbound source is routed to, for channel-override scoping only.
+
+    The pinned :class:`~gateway.session_identity.RoutingIdentity` is authoritative; a bare
+    ``source.profile`` (a routing result without a pinned identity) is the fallback.
+    ``None`` means the launcher/primary scope."""
+    if source is None:
+        return None
+    from gateway.session_identity import identity_of
+
+    identity = identity_of(source)
+    if identity is not None and identity.multiplexed:
+        return identity.runtime_profile or None
+    profile = getattr(source, "profile", None)
+    return profile.strip() if isinstance(profile, str) and profile.strip() else None
+
+
+def _get_channel_override_for_source(runner: Any, config: Any, source: Any) -> Optional[Any]:
+    """``_get_channel_override`` scoped to the config that actually owns *source*.
+
+    ``GatewayRunner.config`` is the LAUNCHER profile's typed config; under multiplex a routed
+    (secondary) profile's chats must match ``channel_overrides`` in THAT profile's own served
+    config from ``_profile_configs`` (populated/refreshed in run_adapters), never the
+    launcher's rules. A missing/unknown/unserved routed profile falls back to NO override
+    (the global default) — it must not borrow another profile's rule. Primary/standalone
+    sources keep the launcher config. ``system_prompt`` resolution is deliberately untouched
+    (different contract, keyed by platform/chat without a routed source)."""
+    from gateway.run import _get_channel_override
+
+    platform = getattr(source, "platform", None)
+    if source is None or platform is None:
+        return None
+    chat_id = str(getattr(source, "chat_id", "") or "")
+
+    def _lookup(cfg):
+        return _get_channel_override(
+            cfg, platform, chat_id,
+            thread_id=str(source.thread_id) if getattr(source, "thread_id", None) else None,
+            parent_id=str(source.parent_chat_id) if getattr(source, "parent_chat_id", None) else None,
+        )
+
+    routed = _routed_profile_for_override(runner, source)
+    primary = getattr(runner, "_primary_profile_name", None) or "default"
+    if not routed or routed == primary:
+        return _lookup(config)
+    return _lookup((getattr(runner, "_profile_configs", None) or {}).get(routed))
+

@@ -0,0 +1,322 @@
+"""Routed-profile channel-override scoping (TGR-01B).
+
+``GatewayRunner.config`` is the LAUNCHER profile's typed config. Under multiplex a routed
+(secondary) profile's Telegram chats (company DM ``1256122537``, company forum
+``-1004426332349`` — exact negative forum identifier) must match ``channel_overrides`` from
+THAT profile's own served config (``_profile_configs``, populated/refreshed in run_adapters),
+never from the launcher's rules. A missing/unknown/unserved routed profile falls back to the
+global default without borrowing another profile's rule. Primary/standalone sources keep the
+launcher config; an explicit session ``/model`` pin stays first priority; ``system_prompt``
+resolution semantics are unchanged.
+
+All fixtures are temporary/mock data; provider resolution is patched — no network calls.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from gateway.config import ChannelOverride, GatewayConfig, Platform, PlatformConfig
+from gateway.run import GatewayRunner
+from gateway.session import SessionSource
+from gateway.session_identity import RoutingIdentity
+
+# Authoritative company targets (fixture copies; no live config is read).
+COMPANY_DM = "1256122537"
+COMPANY_FORUM = "-1004426332349"
+
+QWEN_MODEL = "qwen3.8-max"
+QWEN_PROVIDER = "custom"
+QWEN_URL = "https://llmapi.aliyun.com/compatible-mode/v1/"
+CODEX_MODEL = "gpt-6.1-sol"
+CODEX_PROVIDER = "openai-codex"
+CODEX_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
+LAUNCHER_MODEL = "launcher/model"
+LAUNCHER_PROVIDER = "launcher-prov"
+LAUNCHER_URL = "https://launcher.example/v1"
+TECH_RULE_MODEL = "tech-rule-model"
+TECH_RULE_PROVIDER = "tech-prov"
+TECH_RULE_URL = "https://tech.example/v1"
+
+_PROVIDER_URLS = {
+    QWEN_PROVIDER: QWEN_URL,
+    CODEX_PROVIDER: CODEX_URL,
+    LAUNCHER_PROVIDER: LAUNCHER_URL,
+    TECH_RULE_PROVIDER: TECH_RULE_URL,
+}
+
+
+def _runtime(provider):
+    """A fresh provider runtime fixture (dict is mutated by the resolver: never shared)."""
+    return {
+        "provider": provider,
+        "api_key": "k-" + provider,
+        "base_url": _PROVIDER_URLS[provider],
+        "api_mode": "chat_completions",
+    }
+
+
+def _fake_for_provider(provider, target_model=None):
+    return _runtime(provider)
+
+
+def _tg_config(overrides):
+    return GatewayConfig(
+        platforms={
+            Platform.TELEGRAM: PlatformConfig(enabled=True, channel_overrides=dict(overrides)),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def _company_cfg():
+    """Company profile's OWN served config: DM + forum rules for qwen3.8-max/custom."""
+    return _tg_config({
+        COMPANY_DM: ChannelOverride(model=QWEN_MODEL, provider=QWEN_PROVIDER),
+        COMPANY_FORUM: ChannelOverride(model=QWEN_MODEL, provider=QWEN_PROVIDER),
+    })
+
+
+def _tech_cfg():
+    """A specialist profile with its OWN rule for the same forum id."""
+    return _tg_config({
+        COMPANY_FORUM: ChannelOverride(model=TECH_RULE_MODEL, provider=TECH_RULE_PROVIDER),
+    })
+
+
+def _identity(profile):
+    home = Path("fixture-home") / profile
+    return RoutingIdentity(
+        transport_profile="default",
+        runtime_profile=profile,
+        authorization_home=home,
+        runtime_home=home,
+    )
+
+
+def _pin(source, profile):
+    """Pin the routed identity the way gateway.session_identity.resolve_identity does."""
+    setattr(source, "_identity", _identity(profile))
+    return source
+
+
+def _runner(launcher_cfg, configs=None, primary="default"):
+    runner = object.__new__(GatewayRunner)
+    runner.config = launcher_cfg
+    runner._session_model_overrides = {}
+    runner._profile_configs = dict(configs or {})
+    runner._primary_profile_name = primary
+    return runner
+
+
+def _resolve(runner, source, session_key=None):
+    """Drive the REAL turn entrypoint with patched provider resolution (offline)."""
+    with patch("gateway.run._resolve_gateway_model", return_value=CODEX_MODEL), \
+         patch("gateway.run._resolve_runtime_agent_kwargs",
+               side_effect=lambda: _runtime(CODEX_PROVIDER)), \
+         patch("gateway.run._resolve_runtime_agent_kwargs_for_provider",
+               side_effect=_fake_for_provider), \
+         patch("gateway.run._credential_pool_for_provider", return_value=None):
+        return runner._resolve_session_agent_runtime(
+            source=source, session_key=session_key,
+            user_config={"model": {"default": CODEX_MODEL}},
+        )
+
+
+def _dm_source(profile=None):
+    source = SessionSource(platform=Platform.TELEGRAM, chat_id=COMPANY_DM, user_id="u1")
+    return _pin(source, profile) if profile else source
+
+
+def _forum_source(thread_id=None, profile=None):
+    source = SessionSource(
+        platform=Platform.TELEGRAM, chat_id=COMPANY_FORUM,
+        chat_type="thread" if thread_id else "group",
+        thread_id=thread_id, user_id="u1",
+    )
+    return _pin(source, profile) if profile else source
+
+
+class TestRoutedCompanyRule:
+    """A routed company source must inherit the company profile's own rule (RED on base)."""
+
+    def test_company_dm_inherits_company_rule(self):
+        runner = _runner(_tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _dm_source("company"))
+        assert model == QWEN_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == QWEN_PROVIDER
+        assert runtime["base_url"] == QWEN_URL
+
+    def test_company_forum_root_message_inherits_forum_rule(self):
+        runner = _runner(_tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _forum_source(profile="company"))
+        assert model == QWEN_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == QWEN_PROVIDER
+        assert runtime["base_url"] == QWEN_URL
+
+    def test_company_forum_new_thread_inherits_forum_rule(self):
+        runner = _runner(_tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _forum_source(thread_id="99", profile="company"))
+        assert model == QWEN_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == QWEN_PROVIDER
+        assert runtime["base_url"] == QWEN_URL
+
+    def test_source_profile_without_pinned_identity_scopes_override(self):
+        runner = _runner(_tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        source = SessionSource(
+            platform=Platform.TELEGRAM, chat_id=COMPANY_DM, user_id="u1", profile="company")
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, source)
+        assert model == QWEN_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == QWEN_PROVIDER
+
+    def test_pinned_identity_wins_over_stale_source_profile(self):
+        runner = _runner(
+            _tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg(), "tech": _tech_cfg()})
+        source = _forum_source(thread_id="77", profile="tech")
+        _pin(source, "company")
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, source)
+        assert model == QWEN_MODEL
+        assert model != TECH_RULE_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == QWEN_PROVIDER
+
+
+class TestNoCrossProfileBorrowing:
+    """Only the routed profile's OWN rule applies; never another profile's."""
+
+    def test_specialist_same_forum_uses_own_rule(self):
+        runner = _runner(
+            _tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg(), "tech": _tech_cfg()})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _forum_source(thread_id="77", profile="tech"))
+        assert model == TECH_RULE_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == TECH_RULE_PROVIDER
+        assert runtime["base_url"] == TECH_RULE_URL
+        assert model != QWEN_MODEL
+
+    def test_specialist_without_own_rule_uses_global_never_company(self):
+        runner = _runner(
+            _tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg(), "tech": _tg_config({})})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _forum_source(thread_id="77", profile="tech"))
+        assert model == CODEX_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == CODEX_PROVIDER
+        assert model != QWEN_MODEL
+
+    def test_routed_profile_never_borrows_launcher_rule(self):
+        launcher = _tg_config({
+            COMPANY_FORUM: ChannelOverride(model=LAUNCHER_MODEL, provider=LAUNCHER_PROVIDER),
+        })
+        runner = _runner(launcher, {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _forum_source(thread_id="99", profile="company"))
+        assert model == QWEN_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == QWEN_PROVIDER
+        assert model != LAUNCHER_MODEL
+
+    def test_unserved_routed_profile_falls_back_to_global(self):
+        launcher = _tg_config({
+            COMPANY_DM: ChannelOverride(model=LAUNCHER_MODEL, provider=LAUNCHER_PROVIDER),
+        })
+        runner = _runner(launcher, {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _dm_source("ghost"))
+        assert model == CODEX_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == CODEX_PROVIDER
+        assert model not in (QWEN_MODEL, LAUNCHER_MODEL)
+
+    def test_unknown_source_profile_falls_back_to_global(self):
+        launcher = _tg_config({
+            COMPANY_DM: ChannelOverride(model=LAUNCHER_MODEL, provider=LAUNCHER_PROVIDER),
+        })
+        runner = _runner(launcher, {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        source = SessionSource(
+            platform=Platform.TELEGRAM, chat_id=COMPANY_DM, user_id="u1", profile="ghost")
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, source)
+        assert model == CODEX_MODEL
+        assert model not in (QWEN_MODEL, LAUNCHER_MODEL)
+
+
+class TestPrimaryAndStandaloneUnchanged:
+    """Primary/standalone routing keeps the launcher config exactly as before."""
+
+    def test_primary_identity_uses_launcher_rule(self):
+        launcher = _tg_config({
+            COMPANY_DM: ChannelOverride(model=LAUNCHER_MODEL, provider=LAUNCHER_PROVIDER),
+        })
+        runner = _runner(launcher, {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _dm_source("default"))
+        assert model == LAUNCHER_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == LAUNCHER_PROVIDER
+
+    def test_standalone_source_uses_launcher_rule(self):
+        launcher = _tg_config({
+            COMPANY_DM: ChannelOverride(model=LAUNCHER_MODEL, provider=LAUNCHER_PROVIDER),
+        })
+        runner = _runner(launcher, {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, _dm_source())
+        assert model == LAUNCHER_MODEL
+        assert runtime["provider"] == LAUNCHER_PROVIDER
+        assert runtime["base_url"] == LAUNCHER_URL
+
+
+class TestWarmCacheAndNextTurn:
+    """A legit served-profile cache replacement must reach the warm next turn."""
+
+    def test_warm_agent_signature_changes_after_cache_replacement(self):
+        runner = _runner(_tg_config({}), {})  # company config not served yet
+        source = _dm_source("company")
+        model1, runtime1 = _resolve(runner, source)
+        sig1 = GatewayRunner._agent_config_signature(model1, runtime1, [], "")
+        runner._profile_configs["company"] = _company_cfg()  # run_adapters refresh
+        model2, runtime2 = _resolve(runner, source)
+        sig2 = GatewayRunner._agent_config_signature(model2, runtime2, [], "")
+        assert (model2, runtime2["provider"]) == (QWEN_MODEL, QWEN_PROVIDER)
+        assert sig1 != sig2
+
+    def test_ordinary_next_turn_runtime_picks_new_values(self):
+        runner = _runner(_tg_config({}), {})
+        source = _dm_source("company")
+        model1, runtime1 = _resolve(runner, source)
+        assert (model1, runtime1["provider"]) == (CODEX_MODEL, CODEX_PROVIDER)
+        runner._profile_configs["company"] = _company_cfg()
+        _model2, runtime2 = _resolve(runner, source)
+        assert runtime2["provider"] == QWEN_PROVIDER
+        assert runtime2["base_url"] == QWEN_URL
+        assert runtime2["api_key"] == "k-" + QWEN_PROVIDER
+
+
+class TestSlashAndPromptParity:
+    """The slash/status consumer matches the turn; system_prompt semantics unchanged."""
+
+    def test_slash_channel_override_for_matches_turn(self):
+        runner = _runner(_tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        source = _dm_source("company")
+        override = runner._channel_override_for(source)
+        assert override is not None
+        assert override.model == QWEN_MODEL
+        assert override.provider == QWEN_PROVIDER
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, source)
+        assert (model, runtime["provider"]) == (override.model, override.provider)
+
+    def test_slash_channel_override_primary_source_unchanged(self):
+        launcher = _tg_config({
+            COMPANY_DM: ChannelOverride(model=LAUNCHER_MODEL, provider=LAUNCHER_PROVIDER),
+        })
+        runner = _runner(launcher, {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        override = runner._channel_override_for(_dm_source())
+        assert override is not None
+        assert override.model == LAUNCHER_MODEL
+
+    def test_session_pin_wins_over_routed_company_rule(self):
+        runner = _runner(_tg_config({}), {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        source = _dm_source("company")
+        skey = "agent:company:telegram:dm:" + COMPANY_DM
+        runner._session_state(skey).conversation.model_override = {
+            "model": "explicit/pin", "provider": CODEX_PROVIDER, "api_key": "pin-key",
+        }
+        model, runtime = _resolve(runner, source, session_key=skey)
+        assert model == "explicit/pin"
+        assert runtime["api_key"] == "pin-key"
+
+    def test_system_prompt_resolution_stays_launcher_scoped(self):
+        launcher = _tg_config({
+            COMPANY_DM: ChannelOverride(system_prompt="LAUNCHER PROMPT"),
+        })
+        runner = _runner(launcher, {"company": _company_cfg()})
+        runner._ephemeral_system_prompt = "Global prompt"
+        prompt = runner._get_system_prompt_for_channel(Platform.TELEGRAM, COMPANY_DM)
+        assert prompt == "LAUNCHER PROMPT"
